description.value: Dragonboat Pub is a waterfront pub and restaurant situated on the shores of Skaha Lake in Penticton, offering craft beer, a full bar, and an extensive pub menu ranging from fish and chips to sushi rolls and grain bowls. It is a family-friendly and dog-friendly destination with a patio and a live webcam of the lake. The pub has deep ties to the local community, supporting organizations such as Ronald McDonald House BC and Penticton Paddle Sports.
